text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning developer with 6 years of experience building applied AI systems in Python.

Your project stood out because you’re looking for someone who can help integrate GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion into an existing brand and support the work long term. That combination of customization, deployment, and ongoing collaboration is exactly the kind of setup I’m comfortable with. My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, so I can work across model integration, workflow design, and practical deployment.

One relevant project was a delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant using Python, the OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with the full context when needed. The assistant resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and reached a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. That project required careful agent orchestration, tool calling, and building a system that could fit into an existing business workflow rather than sit beside it.

For your use case, I’d approach the work by first understanding the brand, the customer-facing experience, and the specific way you want GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion to appear in the product. From there, I can help shape the integration so it feels consistent with the brand and is stable enough to extend into future projects. I’m especially comfortable with building systems that need to be iterated on over time, not just delivered once.

If helpful, I can also help think through where GPT-3 should handle text generation and where Stable Diffusion should be used for visual output so the two parts work together cleanly.

What is the first project you want to integrate this into, and what brand experience do you want users to have?
